summaryDeep: Their standards, caution, and sense of responsibility work smoothly with your drive, timing, and willingness to act. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The challenge is remembering that caution and fear can wear similar clothes. Because the pace feels measured, it can be easy to believe that more time, more preparation, or one more adjustment will bring certainty. But certainty is rarely what gets us moving. If you're not careful, the desire that once felt alive can get buried beneath endless refinement. What began as thoughtful timing can quietly become avoidance, and the moment you're waiting for never quite arrives.
advice: This connection works best when discipline gives your drive endurance, not another reason to stay still.
